purpose: Teach: 同性/宣教師/レッテル/滅び/検察庁/結社/投融資/自虐

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、同性カップルへの差別事案を警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: So the police are handling this discrimination case involving same-sex couples, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly leading. Gentle upswing at the end—posing an observation as a question to invite confirmation. Measured pace, curious rather than challenging.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、宣教師ビザを悪用した犯罪も捜査します
lines.en: The police also investigate crimes involving misuse of missionary visas.
lines.style: Clear, factual tone. Even delivery, no inflation. The weight of procedure in each phrase. Professional distance without coldness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者へのレッテル貼りを警察、慎重に避けられてますね
lines.en: So the police are being careful not to label the suspect in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Softer observation now. A note of approval underneath. Slight pause before the closing particle, as if weighing the care being taken.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域社会の滅びを防ぐ防犯活動を続けます
lines.en: The police will continue our crime prevention efforts to protect the integrity of our communities.
lines.style: Formal but grounded. A slight emphasis on 'continue'—steady resolve. Voice sits deeper, more authoritative. The long view of the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、検察庁との連携を警察、強化されてますね
lines.en: So the police are strengthening coordination with the prosecutor's office for this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Observant and almost gentle. Slight tilt toward respect for the coordination. The question lands softly, inviting a fuller picture.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、反社会的結社の摘発に注力します
lines.en: The police will focus our efforts on dismantling organized criminal associations.
lines.style: Steady, with underlying conviction. Not performed—just clearly stated. A hint of weight on 'organized,' as if naming what must be named.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不正投融資の事案を警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: So the police are investigating this case of illegal investment and finance schemes, aren't they?
lines.style: Careful, methodical in phrasing. A slight nod to the complexity. Steady eye-level delivery—Ren checking his understanding with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、自虐的な被害者の心情にも配慮します
lines.en: The police are mindful of the emotional state of victims, especially those who may blame themselves.
lines.style: Warmer turn. The voice opens slightly. A real acknowledgment of harm. Not clinical—this is where procedure meets compassion. Slower pace on the final thought.
